verses.1: And concerning the resurrection of the dead also, hear, and I will tell you: they plant trees, and they make them into planks and cut them into pieces, and they make things from them, because from where there is nothing, God brings forth fruit.
verses.2: The parable of water and of dust.
verses.3: And God washes His creation from
verses.4: the winds; He gathers the souls of water and of dust, and from the sun and from the wind, because from Him it went forth, as it came forth from the flesh.
verses.5: And the Spirit of God gives fruit in their midst; likewise is their resurrection, those who are dead.
verses.7: the earth that dwelt in its place, it became dust; and the water also that dwelt in its place became dew.
verses.8: And the wind also that dwelt in its place became wind; and the fire also that dwelt in its place became the heat of the sun.
verses.9: And the Spirit of God entered into the hand of its Creator, and He causes it to dwell where He wills, so that He may bring it in at the time He wills.
verses.10: And He keeps them in the houses of light, the souls of the righteous; but the souls of sinners He confines in the houses of darkness, until the time He has appointed to bring them out.
verses.11: And He said to Ezekiel the prophet: Call from the four winds, that they may be gathered together and become a spirit.
verses.12: And when he prophesied thus, with one word they were gathered from the four winds.
verses.13: And He brought water, the dew; and again He brought the sun, the heat.
verses.14: And again He brought the earth, the dust; and the wind also He brought, the breath.
verses.15: And God also brought the soul from its dwelling place, from its place of concealment; and with one word they were gathered together, and there was resurrection.
verses.16: And again I have shown you what is like you: evening comes, and you sleep; and morning comes, and you arise. But when you sleep, you are dead.
verses.17: And when you awake, it is a likeness of the resurrection; and the night is a likeness of this world of darkness in its entirety, and all the world sleeps in it, because the darkness of night has covered them.
verses.18: And the dawn of morning also is a likeness of the resurrection of the dead: at that time darkness passes away, and there is light in all the world, and man arises and hastens to his work.
verses.19: And likewise also this renewal of the world and the resurrection of the dead shall come to pass, because this world that passes away is a likeness of this night.
verses.20: And when the sun comes and shines, it is a likeness of this world, as David says: And in the sun He has set His tabernacle.
verses.21: And when He comes in the new world, as now the sun shines when it comes, He Himself, God, will shine over it in the new world; for He says: a sun that does not set, and a light that is not extinguished—He Himself, God, is its light.
verses.22: And again He raises the dead as in the twinkling of an eye. And again I will give you another parable from the seeds that you sow and that live thereby: whether it be a grain of wheat, or a grain of barley, or a grain of peas, or any work of man that is sown in all the earth—if it did not die, there is nothing that would live.
verses.23: And when it dies, its flesh is consumed in the dust together with its husk, as is the flesh of man that you see.
verses.24: And its flesh, consumed in the earth, decays to the measure
verses.25: you see. But if it had not died, it would not sprout and live; and when it sprouts, it brings forth much grain.
verses.26: And fruit is given from God upon that grain which has grown, and it clothes it with flesh as its garment.
verses.27: And tares and thorns and weeds and thistles are not mixed in for you; but see how abundant is the grain of what you sowed.
verses.28: Do not be foolish, but see how abundant your seed is. Even so also is the resurrection of the dead, and as they shall be judged according to their deeds.
verses.29: And again, hear, and I will tell you: seed is not changed into another kind; for if you sowed wheat, does it produce tares?
verses.30: Barley—and if you sowed it, does it produce lentils? And among the trees also, if you planted a fig tree, does it produce grapes? And if you planted a vine, does it produce for you wine?
verses.31: And if you planted a tree of sweet fruit, does it produce bitter fruit? And if you planted a bitter tree, does it become sweet?
verses.32: Even so also, if a sinner dies, does he become righteous at the resurrection? And if a righteous man dies, does he become a sinner at the resurrection? No, but each one shall be judged according to his deeds, and according to the fruit of his work, and according to the work of his hands he shall be judged; and there is none who is condemned for the sin of another.
verses.33: The cedar of Lebanon is planted, and it makes thick branches, great and lofty; but if no dew descends upon it from heaven, its foliage is not beautiful, but it dries up and withers.
verses.34: And likewise it is saturated from its root if the rain of winter does not come down upon it.
verses.35: And likewise, if there does not come down upon them, for life, from God, the dead shall not be raised.
